### Page note: https://mor.news/2019/11/18/cooperative-teams/
Reader state: complete; relevance: partial
**Page:** Cooperative Teams – https://mor.news/2019/11/18/cooperative-teams/  
**Evidence:**  
- **Publication date:** “November 18, 2019”  
- **Author:** “Alden Swiesz”  
- **Entities & descriptions:**  
  - “Oyster River students” – refers to Oyster River High School (ORHS)  
  - “Portsmouth High School” – another school in the co‑op arrangement  
  - “Newmarket students” – mentioned as future co‑op participants  
  - “NHIAA” – New Hampshire Interscholastic Athletic Association  
  - “Andy Lathrop” – ORHS Athletic Director  
  - “Alec Damsell (‘20)” – student athlete on the Clipper‑Cats football team  
  - “Logan Flynn (‘20)” – teammate of Damsell, dual‑sport athlete  
  - “Laura Dreher (‘20)” – student athlete on the Clipper‑Cats girls’ ice hockey team  
  - “Bobcat” – mascot/uniform identifier for ORHS  
- **Measurements & units:**  
  - “Damsell’s only issue is having to drive **20 minutes** to practice”  
  - “Flynn said the practices usually last **two and a half hours**”  
  - “drive **forty minutes** total to and from Portsmouth”  
  - “cost for Oyster River students playing football at Portsmouth is **$500 a year**”  
- **Timelines & conditions:**  
  - Co‑op began “Since 2016” for girls hockey; “starting in the fall of 2018” for the football co‑op; “starting this spring” for Newmarket girls and boys lacrosse; “co‑op teams exist all over the state of New Hampshire” prior to 2019 article.  
- **Other facts:**  
  - “The application … has to be approved by each sports committee, the classification committee and then the council.”  
  - “If approved by the NHIAA, starting this spring Newmarket students will be able to play for the girls and boys lacrosse teams.”  

**Coverage:**  
- **Entities**: list includes schools, athletes, administrative staff, and the sports association.  
- **Dates**: publication date 2019‑11‑18; co‑op start years 2016, 2018; context mentioned “spring” but no specific year.  
- **Measurements**: minutes, hours, dollars.  
- **Group is complete** with respect to the supplied page; no missing rows of a table (the page contains no tables).  

**Missing:**  
- No reference to a professional athlete by name.  
- No discussion of sports scoring methods for multiple types of the same sport.  
- No article from January 2020 referencing the athlete or providing hometown information.  

**Next links:**  
None of the links on this page provide the missing “hometown” fact; they mainly point to other articles about cooperative teams, the author, or general site navigation.
